issue.title: test_ensure_recovers_unpublished_lock_holder_after_grace fails under just check's full parallel lane, passes in isolation
issue.description:
Proposed by epic phase bead sase-tw.6 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #4) while that phase
verified the Textual-free artifact-link derivation module. The node failed only inside
`just check`'s full parallel scoped run and passed on an isolated rerun of the same
unchanged tree, so it is an intermittent full-lane failure rather than a regression
from that phase's diff (which added only `src/sase/artifact_links/derive/` and a
feature-flag registry entry).

Routed here by the sase-tw land agent. The sibling node reported in the same follow-up,
`tests/test_models_panel_edit_outcomes.py::test_on_alias_edited_offers_commit_when_in_repo`,
is already tracked by in-progress task sase-oh and was recorded there as a note instead.

The nearest existing bead, sase-sw, covers a different node in a different file
(`tests/test_axe_outage_incident_regressions.py::TestLeakedOrchestratorIncidentRegression::test_ensure_recovers_wedged_lock_and_restarts_axe`).
Same subsystem and same outward shape, but a different node and a different assertion,
so this is filed per-node rather than corroborated onto sase-sw.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Observed once on 2026-08-25 by phase agent sase-tw.6 on master at 7015c7938: failed
inside `just check`'s escalated full parallel pytest lane, then passed on an isolated

and 0 of 1 serial runs; it has not been shown to reproduce serially. The land agent did
not re-run the full lane, so this record carries the phase agent's observation rather
than a second independent reproduction.
